correctness.rationale: The derivation rule makes the central action B exactly Au∧v+u∧Av and permits an arbitrary central block f before imposing idempotence. For a projection A with image U and kernel W, B has eigenvalues 2, 1 and 0 on ∧²U, U∧W and ∧²W. This gives the stated admissible quotient ranks in both characteristics, including n=2. The only constraints on the lower-left block are f(U)⊆ker B and f(W)⊆im B, giving exactly h_p(r,s) parameters. A central shear with h|U=−f|U, h|W=f|W sends f to zero. The GL(V) lift then conjugates all projections of the same quotient rank; that rank is invariant under any automorphism. Counting complements and central blocks gives the claimed orbit sizes, and the block diagonal representative has rank r+rs. The maximum and collisions follow from the rank quadratic; the displayed examples are consistent. Independent full-matrix tests gave {0:1,2:16} at (n,q)=(2,2), {0:1,2:36} at (2,3), {0:1,3:1408,4:448} at (3,2), and {0:1,2:96} at (2,4) using genuine GF(4).
